% A \par in \title: in the text, in a font group, in italic, sans-serif,
% and typewriter text, and from a macro, beside math, \thanks, a \\ with
% space, and \endgraf. The document builds, and the page's title holds the
% text with a space for each \par.
\documentclass{article}
\newcommand\br{\par}
\title{First\par Second {\Large\bfseries Third\par} {\itshape Fourth\par}
  {\sffamily Fifth\par} {\ttfamily Sixth\par} on $x^2+1$\br
  Seventh\endgraf Eighth\thanks{A note on the title.}\\[1ex] Ninth}
\author{Someone}
\begin{document}
\maketitle
Some text.
\end{document}
